### About

I am a tenure-track Assistant Professor in the [Rutgers Statistics](https://statistics.rutgers.edu/) Department. I am also a visiting researcher at the [Flatiron Institute](https://users.flatironinstitute.org/~lsaul/ml_ccm.html).

Previously, I was a postdoc at the Columbia Data Science Institute, working with [David Blei](http://www.cs.columbia.edu/~blei/).  I received my PhD in Statistics from the University of Pennsylvania, advised by [Edward George](https://statistics.wharton.upenn.edu/profile/edgeorge/) and [Veronika Rockova](http://veronikarock.com/).

My recent research interests include:

- developing identifiable and interpretable deep generative models;
- improved tools for calibrated model criticism.

### Working with me

#### Rutgers PhD students

Send me an email if you'd like to chat about research!

#### Prospective PhD students

Please apply to the Rutgers Statistics PhD program and mention my name. Unfortunately I don't have the bandwidth to reply to every email.

#### Masters of Data Science students

##### Capstone Projects

Rutgers MSDS students can use a final project from one of my MSDS classes as their capstone.  

For capstones based on group projects, students will have to complete a revision independently using a different statistical method, different dataset, or a different simulation design, and submit both the initial group and final individual report.

Please take my MSDS-534 (Statistical Learning for Data Science) course if you are interested in doing an independent research project with me.

:::
